time.rule: downtime does not imply hidden computation; elapsed physical time may be supplied as a later input

thermodynamic_information.logical_policy: append-only history; committed ledger records are never intentionally erased or overwritten
thermodynamic_information.landauer_bound: E_min >= k_B*T*ln(2)*N_erased for logically irreversible erasure
thermodynamic_information.interpretation: UTM verifies logical information-conservation obligations; it does not measure or force hardware heat flow or physical thermodynamic entropy

lineage.model: BLAKE2b-256 linked canonical event commitments plus UTM transition certificates
lineage.fork_policy: only one canonical successor per committed parent/epoch
lineage.storage_policy: append-only + fsync; verify the entire surviving chain before every new commit
lineage.anti_tamper: modification or reordering changes the commitment chain and makes verification fail closed
lineage.loss_model: no absolute no-loss claim; continuity requires at least one surviving verified copy and independent backups for correlated-failure resistance

scope: formal computational world model; not a claim that B612 or its San Francisco is a physical astronomical location, not a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, not thermodynamic zero entropy, and not an absolute guarantee against all information loss
